meta.interpretation: Counted recruiting breast cancer trials in the registry, grouped by country.

coverage.overlap_note: 2452 trials produce 3897 country memberships, so bars can sum to more than the number of trials.

visualization_rationale.reason: A bar chart effectively shows the distribution of recruiting breast cancer trials across different countries.

assumptions: A trial with sites in several countries is counted once in each of those countries.
